Colombia

Extractive sector management

Tax framework

Hydrocarbon exploration and production are governed by Decree 1760 of 2003, which created the Agencia Nacional de Hidrocarburos (ANH), and by the ANH's contract models (E&P contracts and Technical Evaluation Agreements). Royalties are set by Law 756 of 2002 on a sliding scale from 8% to 25% of production, and corporate income tax applies at the general rate.

Licences and contracts

The ANH awards areas through the Proceso Permanente de Asignación de Áreas (PPAA). Contracts are published on the ANH website and on ResourceContracts.org.

Beneficial ownership

Colombia publishes beneficial ownership information through the Registro Único de Beneficiarios Finales (RUB) administered by the DIAN.
